FROM python:3.11-slim
WORKDIR /app
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir fastapi uvicorn httpx
# Build context is the repo root; reach the canonical _start_website.py
# in architecture/DevOpsBuildDeployAndEnvironmentManagement/.
COPY architecture/DevOpsBuildDeployAndEnvironmentManagement/_start_website.py /app/_start_website.py
EXPOSE 80
EXPOSE 443
# Run: docker run -v <certs>:/certs:ro -v <website-staging>:/website:ro \
#                 -p 80:80 -p 443:443 ch-website
ENTRYPOINT ["python", "/app/_start_website.py", "/certs", "/website"]

IdentityCatalog.description: The operator. The only person, the only Global Administrator, and the only identity in the tenant that can create another identity.

Holds no rights and signs in nowhere. It exists because Entra will not accept a service principal as a group's last owner, so the agent groups need a user object to own them. Its password is held by the operator and is recorded nowhere.

CustomRoleCatalog.description: Atlas custom database role dataMigratorRole. Reads the pipeline's published data and the front-end serving data; on the serving database only, may insert documents, create collections and create indexes. On pipelineAdmin it reads and writes the Authorizations record that releases a migration and the reservation that admits one job at a time, and may delete that reservation and nothing else. It holds no update, no delete and no drop over any data anywhere, so a migration can add and can never alter or remove what is already serving users.

Atlas custom database role. Writes the record that authorizes a promotion and the record that says what became of it, across DevOpsAdmin on the front-end cluster. No update, no delete, no drop: a governance record its own writer can alter is not evidence, so an outcome is appended, never edited.
